description: Given a list of integers arr and two indices i and j, both non-negative and smaller than the length of arr, return a new list of the same length in which the element originally at position i is at position j, the element originally at position j is at position i, and every other element is unchanged. If i equals j the list is returned unchanged.
notes: VERINA's Lean postcondition reads result[k]! (with a default value for out-of-range indices) and does not state the length of the result. Both specs add len(result) == len(arr), which the VERINA description states explicitly ("Has the same size as the input array") and which is needed for the indexing to be well defined.
